82:t_012:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whew... Those $$宇宙怪獣$$ sure are tough.」

82:t_012:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If we struggle with enemies this weak, we'll never make it. There are much bigger ones out there.」

82:t_012:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「But fighting these felt a little different from the types we've faced before...」

82:t_012:3.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Maybe they're also $$宇宙怪獣$$, but different ones from a parallel world.」

82:t_012:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...That's our mission complete. Now... Shall we head back to $$メガネビュラ$$?」

82:t_012:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Are you worried about that pink-haired girl?」

82:t_012:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Wait, Princess...! There's still one left!」

82:t_013:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Oh, no! There are people over there!」

82:t_013:2.en:
$$店長$$
「Run, $$ノノ$$...! Don't worry about me...!」

82:t_013:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Your leg... It's pinned under a steel beam...!」

82:t_013:5.en:
$$店長$$
「You can't, $$ノノ$$! Even with your monstrous strength, you can't move this!」

82:t_013:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Ugh...! No! $$ノノリリ$$ wouldn't give up!」

82:t_013:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hard work and guts will make a miracle happen!!」

82:t_013:8.en:
$$店長$$
「Face reality! There are things you just can't do!」

82:t_013:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I will...! I will save you! I'll save you... and then...!」

82:t_015:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「No way...! That girl... moved the beam!」

82:t_016:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Oh, no! That girl got caught on the space monster!」

82:t_016:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「No, $$ディスヌフ$$! Don't let it go!!」

82:t_019:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis! We did it! $$ノノ$$ did it, too!!」

82:t_019:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But I think she's an interesting prospect.」

82:t_020:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'll invite you to our home... $$メガネビュラ$$.」

82:t_021:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「They left without so much as a goodbye...」

82:t_021:2.en:
$$ボス$$
「$$トップレス$$... $$宇宙怪獣$$ we've never seen... A cutie fighting barehanded...」

82:t_021:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「They're completely outside anything we consider normal.」

82:t_021:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「We're near a $$レイライン$$, so $$サイデリアル$$ is likely nearby. It's dangerous to stay here.」

82:t_021:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, return to the ship. We're leaving this area.」

82:t_021:6.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain, we have an incoming transmission. A woman claiming to be an agent of $$破嵐万丈$$.」

82:t_021:8.en:
$$ラム$$
「Yes. She says her name is $$三条レイカ$$.」

82:t_021:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sis $$レイカ$$ is here to meet us!」

82:t_021:10.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$... She's $$万丈$$'s assistant.」

82:t_021:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Understood. We'll follow her instructions from here.」

82:t_100:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's go, $$ディスヌフ$$! Physical Canceller, activate! 《$$エキゾチックマニューバ$$》!」

82:t_101:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「This is a diversion until our real quarry arrives. You'll keep me entertained, $$サイデリアル$$.」

82:t_101:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Shall we do this, $$ヴァンセット$$? 《$$エキゾチックマニューバ$$》!」

82:t_102:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I can't believe so many $$宇宙怪獣$$ entered the atmosphere...!」

82:t_102:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Calm down, Princess. This isn't the world we came from.」

82:t_102:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There's no defense system against the $$宇宙怪獣$$, either. Some of this is unavoidable.」

82:t_102:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I know without you saying it. This is humanity's most precious planet... Earth.」

82:t_102:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「And whatever the world, protecting Earth from the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is our mission as $$トップレス$$.」

82:t_102:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(That's right... That's why we can't lose... The moment we're defeated, our existence becomes meaningless...)

82:t_103:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Even if these aren't the $$宇宙怪獣$$ we know, if they attack, we'll fight back!」

82:t_103:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm used to taking down monsters! I'll take you on with $$マジンガーＺ$$!」

82:t_104:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I never thought $$宇宙怪獣$$ would appear on $$翠の地球$$, too...!」

82:t_104:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I won't hold back against $$バアル$$! We'll fight for $$ノリコ$$, too!」

82:t_105:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ノリコ$$ said it. The fight against the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is a fight for survival...!」

82:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then I'll do it...! I don't intend to die, and humanity doesn't intend to go extinct!」

82:t_106:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We talk about $$バアル$$ and then $$宇宙怪獣$$ show up... Are we cursed...?」

82:t_106:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But this isn't the time for that! If we leave them alone, things will get really bad!」

82:t_107:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't lose, $$鉄人$$! They're humanity's natural enemies!」

82:t_107:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't flinch, even against an unfamiliar enemy! If we lose, everyone in that town will be in danger!」

82:t_108:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I can't believe these things came to Earth while we were with the $$ガルガンティア船団$$...!」

82:t_108:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「As long as we're here, you won't lay a finger on that town! We'll wipe out the lot of you!」

82:t_109:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「So these are those famous $$宇宙怪獣$$! The more I look, the uglier they get!」

82:t_109:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Too bad for you! Your luck ran out when we showed up...! We'll wipe out every last one of you!」
